definitions.gloss: city council; city assembly; the elected legislative body of a Japanese city
definitions.explanation: The elected legislative body of a Japanese {市|し} (city). City council members ({市議会|しぎかい}{議員|ぎいん}) debate local ordinances, approve the city's budget, and oversee the mayor's administration. Parallel bodies exist at other levels: {町議会|ちょうぎかい} for towns and {県議会|けんぎかい} for prefectures.

examples.japanese: {市議会|しぎかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: The city council session has begun.

examples.japanese: {市議会|しぎかい}{議員|ぎいん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The city council election will be held next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{条例|じょうれい}→条例：08255_jourei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{市議会|しぎかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{可決|かけつ}→可決：00148_kaketsu⟧⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{施行|しこう}→施行：06581_shikou⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The new ordinance was passed by the city council and will take effect next year.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧ (city) and ⟦{議会|ぎかい}→議会：02661_gikai⟧ (assembly, council). Each Japanese city has its own {市議会|しぎかい}, with the number of seats roughly proportional to population. Council members serve four-year terms and work alongside — and often in tension with — the separately elected ⟦{市長|しちょう}→市長：12472_shichou⟧ (mayor).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {市議会|しぎかい}{議員|ぎいん}: city council member
- {市議会|しぎかい}⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧: city council election
- {市議会|しぎかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{可決|かけつ}→可決：00148_kaketsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be passed by the city council
- {市議会|しぎかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{否決|ひけつ}→否決：08396_hiketsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be rejected by the city council
- {市議会|しぎかい}⟦{議長|ぎちょう}→議長：02681_gichou⟧: chairperson of the city council

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{議会|ぎかい}→議会：02661_gikai⟧: assembly, legislature (the general term at any level)
- {町議会|ちょうぎかい}: town council (for a ⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧, a smaller municipality)
- {村議会|そんぎかい}: village council
- {区議会|くぎかい}: ward council (for the 23 special wards of Tokyo)
- {県議会|けんぎかい}: prefectural assembly
- ⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧: National Diet (the national parliament)
